name: The Banked Well
pitch: Every well in the world is Earth overcoming Water: line your sea with a Stone Ward, sell the pool you no longer need, and spend all of it on four arts.
questions: Vinegar Cloth's pass of 0.34 lets The One Ladle win 5 of 5 by itself, and the same per-hit model at the common pass loses Pulse and Wall. Should per-hit wards carry the common pass?
Maximum linh lực does exactly nothing on a Stone Ward, because every cost is a share. Is that intended?
Stone Ward's ledger row says 0.125; Combat's range stops at 0.10. This sheet uses 0.10.
